title.narrative: Distribution of in-kind humanitarian aid to those affected by the humanitarian crisis in the Gaza Strip

description.narrative: 1- Supporting the Palestinian Red Crescent Society in light of the reality and challenges facing the Society in bringing aid into the Gaza Strip. 2- The Center’s contribution to covering the logistical work directly related to the distribution of Saudi aid.
Saudi in-kind aid reaches those affected in the Gaza Strip.

Supporting the needs of the Palestinian Red Crescent Society in renting warehouses in the Gaza Strip, purchasing loading equipment, purchasing two four-wheel drive vehicles, and supporting the costs of distributing in-kind aid provided by the King Salman Center for Relief and Humanitarian Action.
